name: Exec Cluster Cost: US Equity — USEquity Commission + 5bps Slippage
description: Tests: USEquity commission ($0.005/share, $1 min, SEC/TAF) + 5bps slippage. Run with --cost us_equity
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER COST: US Equity Commission + Slippage
# Run with: --cost us_equity --cash 100000
# Validates: USEquity per-share commission with SEC/TAF fees, BPS slippage
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: SMA crossover ===
fast = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
golden = crossover(fast, slow)
death = crossunder(fast, slow)
held_long = hold_until()(enter=golden, exit=death)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=30)

atr_val = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=atr_val * 2)
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=10)
